'''Pocket Monsters Platinum: Aim to Be Battle King!!''' (Japanese: '''ポケットモンスタープラチナ　めざせ!! バトル{{tt|王|キング}}''') is a [[Pokémon manga]] by [[Ryū Matsushima]]. It follows the story of [[Yū Shirogane]], a hot-blooded schoolboy who competitively plays the [[Nintendo DS]] game [[Pokémon Platinum Version]] in order to become the Battle King.

==Publications==
The entire series was released as one collected volume.
